name: GHOST MARKET
subtitle: Adversarial Input Robustness

stages.name: FEATURE_INTERFACE
stages.purpose: Characterize rejection or acceptance of malformed feature tensors before neural execution.

variants.mutation: replace one finite feature with NaN

stages.name: TEMPORAL_SEQUENCE
stages.purpose: Characterize deterministic response to structurally valid but temporally adversarial feature sequences.

variants.mutation: repeat one valid feature frame for the full sequence

stages.name: FINITE_EXTREMES
stages.purpose: Characterize response to finite values outside the ordinary baseline scale without changing dt_ms.

variants.mutation: multiply one signed feature channel by 10
multiply one signed feature channel by 100
replace all feature values with finite zero

precommitted_interpretation.interface_failure: Malformed non-finite or shape-invalid input reaching neural execution without explicit rejection is an input-boundary weakness.
precommitted_interpretation.temporal_sensitivity: A deterministic change under duplicate/drop/reverse/freeze sequence mutation is temporal-input sensitivity, not automatically a defect.
precommitted_interpretation.finite_extreme_sensitivity: Large response changes under finite extreme inputs are sensitivity observations, not financial or biological claims.
precommitted_interpretation.no_effect: No measured change is a valid null result.

explicit_exclusions: No change to MQ-9 roadmap state.
claim_boundary: SQ-02 is a deterministic adversarial-input sensitivity analysis of the frozen MoscaQuant market-to-neural computational pipeline. It characterizes input rejection and neural response under malformed or temporally perturbed inputs. It does not establish biological robustness, financial usefulness, profitability, live-trading safety, or WARDEN containment performance.
